title: Weak Bianchi Identities Across Timelike Singularities
exact_target: Decide whether the distributional conservation identity survives the stated class of timelike negative-mass zero-area singularities.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004807 (OWR-8415343-010). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The cited work proves the weak twice-contracted second Bianchi identity for a restricted static spherically symmetric class. Its extension to all admissible timelike singularities is the remaining conjecture. Integrability and the treatment of the singular locus are part of the question; the classical pointwise identity alone does not justify this weak formula.
